newsitem.title: ITALY: Benetton holding expands in eyewear sector.
newsitem.headline: Benetton holding expands in eyewear sector.

text.p: Italy's Benetton family-controlled financial holding 21 Investimenti said it has entered the eyewear sector following an accord with the Lozza family.
The Lozza family is already present on the international market through Italian manufacturer Filospiave and Optifashion, a U.S. distribution company.

Under terms of the agreement, the 21 Investimenti group has acquired via a capital increase a 22 percent stake in the Filospiave group which in turn wholly owns Optifashion and 50 percent of United Optical. The other 50 percent of United Optical is owned by 21 Investimenti.

The Filospiave alliance posted 1996 income of over 100 billion lire ($62.8 million). United Optical had 1996 sales of 35 billion lire through the production and distribution of several brands under the Eyewear of Benetton umbrella.
Investimenti's portfolio already includes companies like Robe di Kappa, Albatros and Enervit.
Apart from the Benetton family, other the holding's other partners include Banco Ambrosiano Veneto, Seragnoli, Assicurazioni Generali and Deutsche Bank.
